column10: THE AUGUST 2026 CORRECTION. This row previously carried 60 kt - OGRA Table 2.1's all-sector kerosene total, rounded to one significant figure, treated in full as household use. OCAC's own sectoral table attributes 24,631 t to Domestic (prior year 17,952), with the rest in industry and government; the sectoral attribution replaces the rounded upper bound.
